marquee.headline: Five business days to move off Klaviyo. Your old account keeps sending the whole time.
paragraphs: List grew. Invoice grew. For most brands the real blocker to switching ESPs isn't the price. It's the rebuild.

Omnisend's migration team does the rebuild for you. Flows, segments, forms, templates and contacts are moved by hand in about five business days, and Klaviyo stays live until you're ready. 730+ brands have already made the move, and Omnisend puts the saving at up to 35% on comparable Standard plans.

After the move, it's the automations that earn the money. Equestrian apparel brand Kerrits lifted revenue-per-email on promotional campaigns by 50% in the four months after switching, and its welcome and cart abandonment emails earned $6.50 per email.

welcome.headline: Email, SMS and push for ecommerce, running off your store data
paragraphs: Omnisend is an email and SMS marketing platform for ecommerce brands on Shopify, WooCommerce and BigCommerce. It reads what shoppers actually did in your store and uses that to run your campaigns and automations: welcome, browse abandonment, cart recovery and post-purchase.
Most of the money comes from automations. Dukier grew the revenue it attributes to Omnisend from €82,857 in 2022 to €518,860 in 2025, and 55% of that came from automated flows.
There's a free plan if you want to test it. If you're on Klaviyo now, Omnisend's team will move your setup over at no cost in about five business days.
